title: GOOD MORNING HOLY SPIRIT
text: Good morning, Holy Spirit. I welcome you into this new day that the Lord has made. I acknowledge your presence in my life, in my home, and in every space I occupy today. Holy Spirit, you are not a force. You are a person. You are the third person of the Trinity, co-equal with the father and the son. And I honor you this morning. I greet you as my helper, my comforter, my teacher, my guide, and my friend. Thank you for dwelling in me. Thank you for making my body your temple. Thank you for the privilege of fellowship with you. Holy Spirit, I invite you to take absolute control of this day. Lead me in the paths of righteousness [music] for your name's sake. Guide me into all truth as Jesus promised. Teach me the deep things of God. Reveal to me the mysteries of the kingdom. Open my eyes to see what the Father is doing so that I may partner with heaven's agenda today. I decree and declare that I shall not walk in my own understanding today, but I shall be led by the spirit of God. For as [music] many as are led by the spirit of God, they are the sons of God, and I am a son, a daughter of the most high. Holy Spirit, I ask you to fill me aresh this morning. Fill every chamber of my heart. Fill my mind with divine thoughts. Fill my mouth with words of grace and wisdom. Fill my hands with power to accomplish kingdom assignments. Let your presence overflow in my life today that wherever I go, people will encounter the atmosphere of heaven. I am a carrier of your glory and I decree that your manifest presence goes with me throughout this day. Holy Spirit, [music] Holy Spirit, I thank you for the fruit that you produce in my life. Love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, meekness, and temperance. I ask that these qualities be evident in all my interactions today. Let love flow through me to everyone I meet. Let joy radiate from my countenance regardless of circumstances. Let peace rule in my heart even in the midst of chaos. Let patience guide my responses when provoked. Let gentleness characterize my approach to difficult people. Let goodness mark all my dealings. Let faith be my response to every challenge. Let me adorn my attitude. Let self-control govern my appetites [music] and desires. I decree and declare that today I walk in the power of the spirit. I am not operating in human strength or natural wisdom. I am anointed with fresh oil. I am energized by supernatural grace. I am enabled by divine ability. Holy Spirit, release your gifts through [music] me today. Let the word of wisdom flow when I need divine strategy. Let the word of knowledge operate when I need divine [music] information. Let the gift of faith arise when I face impossibilities. Let gifts of healing manifest when I encounter the sick. Let the working [music] of miracles be evident when I face insurmountable [singing] obstacles. Let [music] prophecy speak through me to edify, exalt, and comfort. Let discerning [music] of spirits give me insight into spiritual realities. Let diverse kinds of tongues and interpretation [music] flow as needed for kingdom purposes. Holy Spirit, I ask you to sensitize my spirit today. Make me alert to your prompings. Make me sensitive [music] to your leading. Make me responsive to your voice. When you say go, let me go immediately. When you say stop, let me stop instantly. When you say speak, [music] let me speak boldly. When you say be silent, let me hold my peace. I decree that my spiritual ears are open to hear what the [music] spirit is saying. My spiritual eyes are open to see what the spirit is revealing. My spiritual senses are sharp to perceive what [music] the spirit is communicating. Holy Spirit, I declare that you are my teacher today. Teach me how to pray. Teach me how to worship. Teach me how to study the word. Teach me how to relate with people. Teach me [music] how to handle finances. Teach me how to make decisions. Teach me how to overcome temptation. Teach me how to walk in love. Teach me how to represent [music] Christ effectively. Lead me into truth in every area of my life. Correct me [music] when I go astray. Rebuke me when I am wrong. Convict me of sin, righteousness, and judgment. I submit to your instruction. Holy Spirit, I ask you to order my steps today. Direct my path. Open doors that need to be opened. Close doors that need to be closed. Connect me with divine appointment. Disconnect me from destructive associations. Lead me to the right places at the right time. Keep me away from wrong places, wrong people, and wrong [music] situations. Let me walk in divine alignment with heaven's agenda for my life today. I decree that no step I take today is wasted. Every conversation is [music] purposeful. Every encounter is ordained. Every moment is maximized for kingdom advancement. Holy Spirit, I ask for your protection today. Shield me from all evil. Guard me from accidents and calamities. Protect me from the schemes of the enemy. Deliver me from temptation. Keep me from falling [music] into sin. Preserve my mind from evil thoughts. Keep my eyes from sin vanity. Guard my ears from hearing [music] evil reports. Set a watch over my mouth that I may not sin with my tongue. Let the blood of [music] Jesus cover me completely. Let your angels encamp around me. Let no weapon formed [music] against me prosper today. I decree and declare that I am hidden in Christ today. My life [music] is hid with Christ in God. Therefore, I am concealed from the enemy's observation. I am protected from evil projections. I am secured from wicked manipulations. [music] I am shielded from demonic attacks. Holy Spirit, be my covering throughout this day. When danger approaches, alert me. When evil conspires against me, expose it. When the enemy sets traps, reveal them. [music] When darkness plots against me, frustrates their counsel. I walk [music] under divine covering, divine protection, and divine preservation. Father, [music] Holy Spirit, I thank you for the authority [music] you have given me. I am a person of authority because you dwell in me. Greater is he that is in me than he that is in the world. I carry kingdom [music] authority wherever I go today. Demons tremble at my presence because your presence is in me. Circumstances bow to my command because I [music] speak with your authority. Impossibilities give way to possibilities because your power works through me. I am not a victim today. I am a victor. I am not defeated. I am triumphant. I am not weak. I am strong in the Lord and in the power of his might. Holy Spirit, I ask you to anoint my words today. Let every word I speak carry divine weight. Let my declarations produce results. Let my prayers bring breakthrough. Let my counsel bring wisdom. Let my encouragement bring hope. Let my testimony bring glory to God. Let my witness draw people to Christ. I decree that my tongue is the pen of a ready writer. My mouth speaks wisdom. My lips utter knowledge. My words are seasoned with grace. No corrupt communication [music] proceeds from my mouth, but only that which is good for edification that it may minister [music] grace to the hearers. Holy Spirit, I ask you to superintend [music] my thoughts today. Give me the mind of Christ. Let me think your thoughts after you. Deliver me [music] from negative thinking. Free me from fearful imagination. Liberate me from anxious thoughts. Release me from doubtful reasoning. I bring every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ. I cast down every [music] imagination that exalts itself against the knowledge of God. I think on things that are true, honest, just, pure, lovely, and of good report. I meditate [music] on the word of God day and night. My mind is renewed. My thinking is transformed. My imagination [music] is sanctified. I decree and declare that today is a day of favor. Holy Spirit, release favor [music] upon my life. Did me favor with God and with man. Let me find favor in the eyes of everyone I meet. Let doors of opportunity open because of favor. Let promotions [music] come because of favor. Let blessings overtake me because of favor. Let divine [music] connections happen because of favor. Let supernatural provision manifest because of favor. I [music] walk in uncommon favor today. I operate under divine favor [music] today. I experience unusual favor. Today, the favor of the Lord makes me rich and adds no sorrow. [music] Holy Spirit, Father, Holy Spirit, I ask you to give me boldness today. Make me bold as a lion. Give me holy confidence. [music] Remove every spirit of timidity. Cast out every demon of fear. Break every bondage of intimidation. I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ. I AM NOT AFRAID [music] to stand for righteousness. I am not intimidated by opposition. I am not moved by threats. I am not shaken by challenges. I am bold because you are with me. I am courageous because YOU HAVE PROMISED NEVER to leave me nor forsake me. I am confident because you are my strength and my shield. Holy Spirit, I ask you to increase my hunger for God today. Create in me a deeper thirst for righteousness. Stir up a greater passion for prayer. Intensify my desire for the word. Enlarge my appetite for worship. expand my capacity for intimacy with God. Let me hunger and thirst after righteousness that I may be filled. Let me seek first the kingdom of [music] God and his righteousness. Let me delight myself in the Lord that he may [music] give me the desires of my heart. Let me draw near to God that he may draw near to me. Let me pursue the presence of God with all my heart. I decree and declare that today I walk in divine health. Holy Spirit, you are my healer. You are my strength. You are my life. By the stripes of Jesus, I am healed. By his [music] wounds, I am made whole. My body is the temple of the Holy Ghost and no sickness can dwell in God's temple. I command every pain to leave my body. I command every disease to depart from my system. I command every weakness to be replaced with strength. I command every malfunction to be corrected. I walk in the blessing of wholeness. I operate in supernatural strength. I live in divine health. Holy Spirit, I ask you to bless my work today. Prosper the work of my hands. Let everything I touch be blessed. Let every project I undertake succeed. Let every assignment I handle excel. Let every task [music] I perform bring excellent results. Give me wisdom to do my work with excellence. Give me grace to complete assignments [music] on time. Give me favor to receive recognition and reward. I decree that I am diligent in my work. I am faithful in my responsibilities. I am excellent in my performance. I am a blessing to my workplace. I bring value to my organization. I add worth to every environment I enter. Holy Spirit, Father, I decree and declare that today I am a blessing to my generation. Holy Spirit, [music] use me as an instrument of blessing. Make me a channel of your grace. Make me a vessel of your mercy. Make me a conduit of your love. Make me an agent of transformation. Make me a catalyst for revival. Let people's lives be changed because they encounter me. Let people be healed because they touch my shadow. Let people be delivered because they hear my voice. Let people be saved because they witness my testimony. I am salt and light in this world. I am a city set on a hill that cannot be hidden. I am the fragrance of Christ unto God. Holy Spirit, I commit this entire day into your hands. Take control of every hour. Manage every minute. Redeem every second. Let nothing be wasted. Let nothing be lost. Let nothing be stolen. Maximize this day for your glory. Optimize this day for kingdom purposes. Utilize this day for divine assignments. I shall not procrastinate today. I shall not be distracted today. I shall not be derailed today. I stay focused on what matters. I prioritize what is important. I accomplish what is essential. I decree and declare that at the end of this day, I shall have testimonies to share. [snorts] I shall have victories to celebrate. I shall have blessings to count. I shall have breakthroughs to [music] announce. This is not just another day. This is a day of divine visitation. This is a day of supernatural manifestation. This is a day of kingdom demonstration. This is a day of glory revelation. Holy Spirit, make this day count. Make this day memorable. Make this day fruitful. Make this day impactful. Holy Spirit, I love you. I honor you. I worship you. I adore you. I magnify you. I exalt you. You are worthy of all praise. You are deserving of all glory. You are entitled to all honor. Thank you for this new day. Thank you for life and health. Thank you for strength and grace. Thank you for mercy and favor. Thank you for guidance and direction. Thank you for protection and provision. Thank you for being my constant companion. My faithful friend, my trusted counselor, my divine helper. I declare that today belongs to the Lord. This day is sanctified. This day is consecrated. [music] This day is dedicated to the glory of God. I shall not leave this day for myself. I shall leave it for the one who died for me and rose again. I shall walk worthy of the calling [music] wherewith I am called. I shall run the race that is set before me with patience. I shall fight the good fight of faith. I shall lay hold on eternal life. I shall finish strong. I shall end [music] well. I shall hear the master say, "Well done, good and [music] faithful servant. Holy Spirit, [music] thank you, Holy Spirit, for hearing me. Thank you for answering me. Thank you for walking with me. Thank you [music] for talking with me. Thank you for staying with me. I go forth in your power. I move forward in your grace. I advance in your strength. I proceed in your wisdom. This is the day [music and singing] that the Lord has made. I will rejoice and be glad in it. In the mighty name of [music] Jesus Christ, I have prayed. Amen. And amen.
